title: The Noisy Mind
caption:
It's two in the morning and you're back in the meeting. Not the whole meeting. Just the bit where you said the thing.

The replay feels like thinking. It isn't. Nothing new arrives on the fortieth lap, and the person across the table went home and forgot about it hours ago.

Send this to someone who replays conversations in bed.

The Noisy Mind. Out now.
